newsitem.title: GERMANY: Fragments of rare Gutenberg bible found in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Fragments of rare Gutenberg bible found in Germany.

text.p: Fragments of a rare Gutenberg bible have been found in church archives in the north German town of Rendsburg, a report in a local newspaper said on Friday.

The Schleswig-Holsteinische Landeszeitung said the bible was discovered a year ago, but only recently certified by experts to be one of the 180 bibles put together by Johannes Gutenberg, the inventor of printing by movable type, in the town of Mainz between 1453 and 1455.
"According to experts, the bible is a priceless work and the oldest printed book in Schleswig-Holstein," the newspaper said.
There are 48 other known Gutenberg bibles still in existence.
